gaps.eager_expert_input_frontier: For four archived prefills, all 160 EP16 generations bound by source/receiver counts and local native tasks. Within each carrier the DP-crossing count interval width divided by its floor is 2.875%, 0.371%, 0.731%, 430.205%. A one-arrival-per-source-token per opposite DP path can remove at least 1.371, 2.638, 2.697, 0.730 GB of logical duplicate input from this partition, before any intra-DP fanout. gaps.natural_expert_delivery: One frozen C8 route census on 171. Four actual carriers 416/816/817/834, 160 EP16 layer calls, 61440 expert counters reconcile exactly across all sources. On natural routes, direct same-destination-rank reuse removes 3.990 GB logical cross-card input; a sibling-chip relay can replace another 3.424 GB on this boundary with local fanout. Across actual expert order the full direct reuse window needs up to 5115 live rows. Six-slot ordered return with one reducer card and original hottest-card row capacity saves 6.491 GB in the vector model. With no balance constraint, moving FP32 state between slots adds only 11.315 MB of byte savings vs the best single reducer. Diagnostic texts and six counters match and stock service restored. No production speedup measured.

broader_workload_evidence.next: M03 优先重用 171 上已记录的普通输入行数、完整块成员及每请求回放次数，给短上下文索引生成和四个消费者联合定价。分开核对 K≤512 的完整 token 覆盖和 K>512 的完整块覆盖。只在同形状的净节省足以影响普通对话或短回复时深入实现。M10 三层草稿跨卡到达的既有切片仍在队列。
